subject: Renewal + Expansion: Pricing follow-up - volume step-ups & blended rates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + pricing follow-up (volume step-ups / blended rates)

Hi Jenna - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can align with Acme Health procurement/finance: 

Call highlights:
- Current steady-state usage: ~150M tokens/month (mostly chat+summaries).
- 12-month forecast: ramp to ~300M in Q2 -> 600M mid-year -> 800M by Q4 depending on new product routes.
- Primary ask: confirm target unit economics (target $/1M tokens) and whether we should price by model family or a blended route-level rate.

Budget notes you shared:
- Target monthly spend range: $40k - $90k (flexible based on SLA / add-on routes).
- Internal preference: aim for a target of ~$1,500 per 1M tokens as the negotiation anchor.

Proposed next steps (from Redwood):
1) I will send a short pricing/volume proposal showing step-up tiers and an example blended $/1M at your 600M forecast.
2) You confirm whether the summarization route will be routed to our optimized summarization model (adds ~5% to unit cost) or sent to the standard chat route.
3) If acceptable, we prepare an amendment for the renewal that includes volume step-ups and blended-rate language; finance will need a PO to lock pricing.

Attached: draft pricing worksheet + usage export (see file names).

Would you confirm the target $/1M (you mentioned $1.5k) and whether the new summarization route should be included in the blended rate?

Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Jenna Park <jenna@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pricing follow-up (volume step-ups / blended rates)

Thanks Marissa - quick clarifications: 

- Confirming our current baseline is ~150M/mo. Forecast is accurate: we expect to be at ~300M by end of Q2 and likely 600-800M within 9-12 months if the new notification and summarization routes go live.
- Budget: the $40k-$90k range is what Finance gave us for the coming year; we can stretch to the high end with clear unit economics.
- Target $/1M: Yes, $1,500 per 1M tokens is the target that will get signed off by our product leadership - ideally lower but that's our internal goal.
- Summarization route: we'd like that routed to your optimized summarization model (higher quality outputs for short summaries). If routing adds incremental cost, include that as a line item and show blended vs non-blended options.

Next: please send the proposed tiers and a blended example for our forecast. Also include any one-time onboarding/quantization dev costs if relevant.

Best,
Jenna
Head of Product, Acme Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing proposal: volume step-ups + blended-rate example (attached)

Hi Jenna - attached is the pricing worksheet (redwood-pricing-proposal-v3.pdf) and the usage breakout (usage-breakdown-2026.csv). Summary below: 

Proposed step-up tiers (list price per 1M tokens):
- 0 - 50M: $3,200 / 1M
- 50 - 250M: $1,800 / 1M
- 250 - 1,000M: $1,250 / 1M

Notes on blended pricing:
- Using your forecasted monthly shape (300 -> 600 -> 800), the blended $/1M across billed tokens comes to ~$1,420 / 1M (projected at ~600M). That gets us close to your $1,500 target.
- Summarization route using the optimized summarization model: +5% uplift on unit cost (model-specific routing). If you want a dedicated route with stronger QoS or higher SLA we typically add +10-15% depending on isolation needs.
- If you add new model routes (e.g., a specialized NLU model for triage), treat those tokens as an additive bucket; we can include them in the blended calculation or price them as a separate line (recommended for clarity).

Early-commit discount: 
- If Acme commits to a 12-month minimum annual token commit (prepay or invoiced monthly with PO), we can apply an additional 10% off listed step tiers (effectively moving the 250-1,000M tier to ~$1,125 / 1M).

Margin / legal note: applying the early-commit discount will require finance approval; I'm copying internal ops to confirm.

Proposed asks from Acme for the proposal to move forward:
1) Confirm you want the summarization route included in the blended rate (yes, you indicated yes).
2) Confirm target monthly forecast to lock a starting tier.
3) If approving early-commit discount, let us know billing preference (prepay vs PO monthly).

If that looks good, I'll draft an amendment to the renewal and loop legal for redlines.

Thanks - attaching files for procurement review.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme renewal - pricing/discount ask (do not forward)

Internal note (do not forward to customer):
- Customer anchor: target $1,500 / 1M. Our proposed blended ~$1,420 is acceptable but margin-light if we include the +5% summarization uplift. Early-commit discount (10%) will reduce blended to ~1,278 / 1M - confirm finance OK.
- Key asks for finance/legal: can we accept up to 12% total concessions (including PO terms) for strategic expansion accounts? Need confirmation by EOD so I can include in amendment.
- If finance pushes back, alternate: offer a separate dedicated summarization route at +10% (keeps base blended higher).

I plan to send the amendment draft to Jenna by EOD with the blended example and the early-commit option.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme renewal - pricing/discount ask (do not forward)

Marissa - quick confirm from finance: we can support up to a 12% net concession for strategic expansion accounts provided a 12-month commit with standard net-45 payment terms and PO on file. Early-commit (prepay) would allow an extra 2% (so up to 14%) but we'd need Treasury sign-off.

Recommendation: proceed with the amendment offering the 10% early-commit discount option (prepay or PO monthly) and include an explicit separate line for the summarization route (+5%). That keeps the blended math transparent.

I'll ask legal to queue the amendment template and notify Treasury if they pick prepay.

Neha
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
